components.name: AES-128-CBC (aes-js) — legacy pyethsaletool crowdsale wallet decryptor

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The library's core signing curve (via @noble/curves/secp256k1): ECDSA signing (signing-key.ts:64), signature parse/serialize, public-key derivation and recovery, point arithmetic, and ECDH shared-secret key agreement (computeSharedSecret, signing-key.ts:97-99). All Shor-vulnerable. Migration: signatures → ML-DSA-65/SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s; ECDH → ML-KEM-768. Changeable here — it is the library's own API surface, constrained by Ethereum protocol compatibility.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Math.random used only for non-security purposes in this codebase: retry-backoff jitter (src.ts/utils/fetch.ts:558,578), provider-order shuffling (src.ts/providers/provider-fallback.ts:22), and a test value (_tests/test-providers-errors.ts:183). All wallet/key/IV/salt entropy goes through randomBytes() backed by node:crypto/WebCrypto CSPRNG (reported as a separate finding). Weak-PRNG exposure (CWE-338) is limited to jitter/shuffle, not secrets.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Default third-party RPC provider API keys hardcoded for zero-config UX: Etherscan (919b412a057b5e9c9b6dce193c5a60242d6efadb), QuickNode proapi token, Alchemy (_gg7wSSi0KMBsdKnGVfHDueq6xMB9EkC), Ankr (9f7d929b...), Blockscout — in src.ts/providers/provider-{alchemy,ankr,blockscout,quicknode}.ts and build twins. Real bearer credentials shipped in source (CWE-798/321); they are well-known public demo keys; rotating them breaks the out-of-the-box defaults but is changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Two parameter families: (1) BIP-39 mnemonic→seed at src.ts/wallet/mnemonic.ts:147 — PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512, 2048 iterations, 64-byte dkLen; the count is fixed by BIP-39, changeable only by breaking mnemonic compatibility. (2) Legacy pyethsaletool crowdsale format at src.ts/wallet/json-crowdsale.ts:58 — PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256, 2000 iterations, password used as its own salt, 16-byte AES key; parameters fixed by the historical wallet file format being read. The .d.ts sites are the shipped API declaration s

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-128-CTR is the cipher of the Web3 Secret Storage V3 keystore: encryption writes cipher "aes-128-ctr" (src.ts/wallet/json-keystore.ts:304) and decryption dispatches on it (:75). CTR provides no authentication — integrity is the separate keccak256 MAC field. Mode fixed by the keystore standard; changeable only by breaking keystore-format compatibility.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: @noble/curves/secp256k1 is declared in package-lock.json and is the shipped implementation of the library's signing curve — actively used (see ALG-673c8f24: ECDSA sign/verify, public-key recovery, ECDH). Shor-vulnerable; signature migration ML-DSA-65/SLH-DSA, ECDH migration ML-KEM-768; replacement requires an Ethereum-protocol-level decision, not just a library patch.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: Ed25519 support ships inside the locked @noble/curves package. No call site in this codebase's source — available in the shipped library whether or not the application calls it (observable here, replaceable only by the vendor). Ed25519 is Shor-vulnerable; ML-DSA-65/SLH-DSA is the replacement where used.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: P-256 (secp256r1) support ships inside the locked @noble/curves package. No call site in this codebase's source — available in the shipped library. Shor-vulnerable ECDSA/ECDH curve; ML-DSA-65 / ML-KEM-768 where used.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt KDF for keystore wallets: decrypt accepts kdf "scrypt"; encrypt derives the key with default N=2^17 (131072), r=8, p=1 (src.ts/wallet/json-keystore.ts:260) via node:crypto scryptSync or @noble/hashes scrypt. Memory-hard KDF, PQ-irrelevant; N=2^17 is below current 2019+ guidance but matches the keystore ecosystem default. Changeable here via EncryptOptions.scrypt.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keccak-256 via @noble/hashes/sha3 (keccak_256, src.ts/crypto/keccak.ts:16) — the Ethereum hash: address derivation and EIP-55 checksums, transaction hashes, signing digests, EIP-712 typed-data hashing, solidity packed hashing, keystore MAC. Grover-only PQ impact; adequate.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: PBKDF2 KDF family: BIP-39 seed derivation (2048×HMAC-SHA512), keystore decrypt path accepting kdf "pbkdf2" with count read from the file (Web3 V3 files typically 600000+; count is file-controlled), the legacy crowdsale KDF, and the exported pbkdf2 implementation surface (crypto-browser.ts:49 pbkdf2Sync).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-128 as used by the keystore wallet cipher (aes-128-ctr; key = first 16 bytes of the scrypt/PBKDF2-derived key). Same sites as the CTR-mode object viewed under the block-cipher rule. AES is symmetric and PQ-adequate at 128 bits (Grover-only); no PQ migration needed for the cipher itself.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256 implementation (src.ts/crypto/sha2.ts via node createHash; browser via @noble/hashes sha256) backing computeHmac("sha256"), BIP-32 hash160 fingerprints, wordlist checksums and the legacy crowdsale KDF. Grover-only PQ impact; adequate.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: @noble/hashes sha256 module is declared in package-lock.json and actively used — it is the browser-build SHA-256 backing computeHmac, BIP-32 fingerprints and the crowdsale KDF (see ALG-695a1eb5).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: @noble/hashes blake3 module ships in the locked package. No call site in this codebase's source — available in the shipped library whether or not called. Grover-only PQ impact for BLAKE3.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: @noble/hashes sha3 module is declared and actively used — keccak_256 from it is THE Ethereum hash in this library (see ALG-052c24b2: addresses, tx hashes, signing digests). Grover-only PQ impact.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-512 implementation (src.ts/crypto/sha2.ts:13 createHash("sha512"); browser @noble/hashes sha512) — the inner hash of computeHmac("sha512") for BIP-32 HD derivation and of PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512 for BIP-39. No SHA-384 call site exists in this codebase (rule name covers both variants).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Crypto provider: @noble/hashes (sha256, sha512, sha3/keccak, ripemd160, hmac, pbkdf2, scrypt modules) — the primary crypto provider of the browser build, actively used by src.ts/crypto/* (crypto-browser.ts:3-6, keccak.ts:7, ripemd160.ts:1, scrypt.ts, pbkdf2.ts); version pinned in package-lock.json decides available parameter sets and known-vulnerability posture.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Crypto provider: @noble/curves — secp256k1 is actively used (signing-key.ts:7: ECDSA sign/verify, public-key derivation/recovery, ECDH getSharedSecret); Ed25519/P-256 modules ship in the package without local call sites. Version pinned in package-lock.json; its version decides side-channel fixes and API surface.
